business.pageDescription: Seva me Sirsa is a digital platform designed to strengthen the connection between citizens and their elected representatives. We provide a transparent, efficient, and accountable mechanism for support request redressal at the constituency level.
business.mission.title: Our Mission
business.mission.desc: To provide citizens with a transparent, efficient, and time-bound platform for filing and tracking civic support requests with their MLA constituency office.
business.vision.title: Our Vision
business.vision.desc: A system where every citizen's voice is heard, every support request is addressed, and governance becomes more responsive and accountable.
business.values.title: Our Values
business.values.desc: Transparency, accountability, citizen-centricity, efficiency, and democratic participation in local governance.
business.benefit.citizens.title: For Citizens
business.benefit.citizens.desc: Easy filing, real-time tracking, guaranteed accountability, and fair resolution of support requests.
business.benefit.admin.title: For MLA Staff
business.benefit.admin.desc: Streamlined Request management, better organization, data-driven insights, and improved efficiency.
business.benefit.govt.title: For Department
business.benefit.govt.desc: Real-time support request analytics, better resource allocation, performance metrics, and improved citizen satisfaction.
business.feature.digital: Digital-first approach ensuring accessibility to all
business.feature.transparent: Complete transparency in Request status and resolution
business.feature.accountable: Accountability at every stage of support request redressal
business.feature.inclusive: Inclusive design supporting multiple languages and accessibility
business.ctaTitle: Ready to File Your First Support Request?
business.ctaDescription: Join thousands of citizens who are already using Seva me Sirsa to get their concerns addressed. Your voice matters, and we're here to ensure it's heard.
